title: Digging the Marrow - Excavation on an Alien World
author: crhelix
selftext: This is my first release of a game I have been working on for a few months. If you ever remembered the old flash game "Motherload", it takes a lot of inspiration from that with more rpg and exploration elements. I've worked on a lot of projects bt the speed of ClaudeCode finally gave me something I can call playable and complete instead of a project that gets half-finished and forgotten. It is not as flashy as some of the projects I have seen on here but I am a sucker for old old style games and made what I wanted to play. Hope you can find some enjoyment from it.
